payload.credit_html: Cretaceous Crocodyliforms from the Sahara. ZooKeys 28: 1–143. doi:10.3897/zookeys.28.325
payload.description_html:
Skeleton of the crocodyliform Anatosuchus minor. Skull and partial postcranial skeleton (MNN GAD17) in dorsal view. Scale bar equals 10 cm. Pink tone indicates restored snout margin. Abbreviations: co1, cervical osteoderm 1; do1, 5, 12, dorsal osteoderm 1, 5, 12; f, femur; fi , fi bula; h, humerus;

l, left; ma, manus; r, right; ti, tibia.
